# Realty News Now

> Realty News Now is a free Texas real estate news app and publishing platform from Caxton Publications, Inc. It combines the magazines RealtyLine (Austin) and Newsline San Antonio with daily news, a real estate event calendar, digital magazine issues, builder and community inventory, giveaways, and advertising for REALTORS®, brokers, builders, lenders, and title professionals. Austin and San Antonio are live. Houston and Dallas/Fort Worth editions are coming soon.

Brand relationships: Realty News Now (launched May 2026) is the app and website at https://realtynewsnow.app. RealtyLine is the Austin and Central Texas monthly magazine, founded in 1995. Newsline San Antonio is the San Antonio and South Texas monthly magazine, founded in 1982 and relaunched in 2025. Both are published by Caxton Publications, Inc., an independent, family-run publisher. The company is a member of or partner with NAR, Texas REALTORS®, the Austin Board of REALTORS®, the San Antonio Board of REALTORS®, the Home Builders Association of Greater Austin, and the Greater San Antonio Builders Association.

## Audience and reach (from the 2026 media kit)
- RealtyLine Austin: 16.5K+ print copies per issue, 44K+ email subscribers, 6.64M+ annual email sends, 204K+ email opens, 21K+ annual clicks, 3.1% open rate, 0.32% click rate
- Newsline San Antonio: 20,000 email subscribers
- Open rates are verified human engagement; Apple Mail Privacy Protection and bot activity have been filtered out of open-rate reporting since June 2024
- Source: https://realtynewsnow.app/advertise
